section.heading: FR-1 Beneficiary currency validation
section.text:
The system shall reject an international transfer when the beneficiary currency is not supported for the
destination country. The customer sees error 003040.

cards.text: An international transfer is rejected with error 003040 when the beneficiary currency is not supported for the destination country.
